lesson: Search for existing reports on the same boundary before filing.

title: PowerShell dangerous-command classifier bypass

lesson: Confirm the scope covers the component before filing.
summary: Proven bypass via git clean-filter; closed out of scope with a −1 point penalty.
title: git clean-filter bypass

lesson: Paste the full run log inline. 'Available on request' is not evidence.
summary: Classifier bypass via a POSIX wrapper; closed because the submission had text-only claims and no reproducible PoC attached.
title: POSIX wrapper bypass

lesson: Read the program's exclusions, not just its scope.
summary: Proven live on Grafana v13.3.1, but Intigriti's AI review flagged it out-of-scope: 'Sessions not being invalidated' is an explicit exclusion.
title: Session token survives rotation
